notes.title: Hint button added, 22/12/2022
notes.content:
Hint button update!


 Press the hint button in the hub for a clue on where to go next, make sure you check the box in the pause menu first.
 The first time you hit continue with an old savefile (pre-hint) it has to update and check your progress, which could take a few moments. This will only happen once per save.

If you have any problems with this let me know!

Other fixes:
 Fixed a bug where it could save an unreachable configuration in the air-maze
 Various other small fixes and improvements

notes.title: Small Bug Fixes 16/09
notes.content:
Patch Notes 16/09/2022:


 Updated the telescope texture in Universe to the new JWST Deep Field picture ;) 
 Fixed a bug where the plant gate in Air wouldn't save correctly sometimes
 Fixed an issue with the Water elevator not showing correctly 
 Fixed an issue where you would respawn constantly in Air (let me know if it still happens!)
 Fixed a bug where Universe wouldn't load properly
 Minor collision improvements and bugfixes


Thanks to everyone reporting bugs, it still helps!

notes.title: Bug Fixes 30th May
notes.content:
Patch Notes 30/05/2022:


 the laserpath puzzle in space is now interactable even after completing it.
 fixed a bug in the same puzzle where it wouldn't save properly.
 fixed a bug where rumble wouldn't end after certain events in air.
 fixed a bug in water where the puzzle with the three coloured path pieces didn't save properly.
 fixed a cheese where you could skip a puzzle by manipulating the icy gate in a certain way.
 fixed a small visual bug where the triangle puzzle in space had differently coloured pips sometimes.
 fixed a bug where the first fire laser could get stuck.
 fixed a bug where the hub's coordinates wouldn't show properly.
 fixed a bug where the hub lasers wouldn't end properly.

notes.title: Bugfixes 23th May
notes.content:
Patch notes 23/05/2022:


 fixed an issue in Air where the rotating bridges could get stuck inside a platform.
 fixed an issue in the tutorial-world where the big sphere could spawn too close to the ground.
 telescopes require only one click to go inside now.
 various small gameplay improvements.

notes.title: Bugfix / softlock update May 22nd
notes.content:
Fixed a softlock in Earth, the rock pillar is no longer interactable after completing that puzzle.

Other patchnotes for 22/05/2022:

 added invert y in menu -> gameplay!
 'endmusic' can no longer be interrupted by normal music.
 various small gameplay and collision improvements.

notes.title: Music update 21th May!
notes.content:
Made a big oopsie and never toggled music=on... Well, there's music now!

Other patchnotes for 21/05/2022:


 fixed an issue with the Earth tunnels.
 other small collision and gameplay improvements.

notes.title: Small menu bugfix 20th May
notes.content:
Patchnotes 20/05/2022:


 Fixed some issues with the main menu.
 New game no longer overwrites the old save file.

notes.title: Small bugfix update May 18th
notes.content:
Patchnotes 18/05/2022:


 improved collision in several places, including stepping stones puzzle in fire.
 menu has a back button on every submenu now.
 fixed a bug where you could fall through hub floor. (if it still happens let me know!)
 various small gameplay improvements.
 added extra checks to see if current savegame is valid (to fix the tutorial-skipping).

If you accidentally skipped the tutorial world (and didn't get the 'fire' achievement), let me know!

notes.title: Small bugfix update May 16th
notes.content:
Patchnotes 16/05/2022:


 fixed a bug where the screenshake wouldn't go away.
 fixed an issue where Earth's tunnels wouldn't appear correctly.
 fixed an issue where the lights in the solid-link puzzle wouldn't show the correct colour.
 improved respawns, puts you further back so bad respawn chances are minimised.
 helical tower in Air now has a discrete stop in the middle station.
 other various small gameplay improvements.


known issue:

 There's a small chance that the tutorial won't appear correctly.

notes.title: Small update May 15th
notes.content:
Patchnotes 15/05/2022:


 Postgame is now enabled, after finishing the game you can continue and go back to explore further.
 fixed an issue where the debug menu could be opened.
 fixed an issue where the pillar puzzle was too fast on high framerates.
 fixed an issue where the fire underground area could despawn.
 updated an option on the menu to also show gamepad a-button to toggle walking forward with.
 updated some sounds.

notes.content:
